start_here: Say to your AI: "Find the workflow for making short vertical videos from my recorded footage." It asks tool:workflow-run-find with those words and hands back the workflows that fit, each with the exact input that starts it.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing and names no list: it reads the shipped workflows and the workflow rows the caller hands in as own, and answers the matches.
instructions: 1. Say the job in a few words (words), and name the kinds of moment it is, if you know them (kinds), from the kinds a workflow waits for.

2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:workflow-run-find and input {words, kinds?, own?}; own is the person's own workflow rows, each {id, value}, read from wherever the person keeps them.
3. Read matches: each names the workflow, its job, why it matched, and next, the exact input for wf start (the start op is not built yet) that starts it.
4. If unknown_kinds lists a kind, no workflow waits for it: drop it or use another from the kinds the matches name.

worked_examples.title: A job in words finds the workflow that makes short videos
worked_examples.ask: Find the workflow for making short vertical videos from my recorded footage.

input.words: make short vertical videos from my recorded footage

worked_examples.given: The words above, and no kinds and no own rows.
worked_examples.hands_back: matches[0].workflow is workflow:make-short-videos-from-footage with why "words 20.0" and next {tool: workflow-run-start, input: {workflow: workflow:make-short-videos-from-footage, input: {request: ...}}}; chooser "not asked: no kinds given".
